PROFILE.name: Srijan Bhattacharyya
PROFILE.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
PROFILE.about-me: Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) graduate focused on embedded systems, robotics, and the integration of hardware and software. Interested in building practical engineering systems spanning microcontrollers, connected devices, Linux-based platforms, and intelligent software. Current interests include autonomous robotics, embedded development, control systems, and bio-inspired flying robots. I value open engineering, iterative prototyping, systematic testing, and continuous learning.
PROFILE.short-description: Embedded systems, robotics, and software engineering at the hardware–software boundary.

EDUCATION.university: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology

PROJECTS.name: I.S.H.A (Integrated Systematic Heuristic Agent)
PROJECTS.description: An open-source, multi-layered framework exploring the intersection of philosophy, psychology, artificial intelligence, and robotics. The project aims to develop modular reasoning, goal-oriented behaviour, and an extensible foundation for intelligent systems.

PROJECTS.name: DevOS EcoSystem
PROJECTS.description: A proposed ecosystem of operating systems and shared services for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, wearables, Raspberry Pi systems, and vehicles. Its planned components include a shared core, DevPKG package manager, and OctaConn connectivity layer for customization and cross-device integration.

PROJECTS.name: The AVR/ESP Programmer Board
PROJECTS.description: A compact programmer-board project intended to support AVR microcontrollers through ISP and ESP microcontrollers through UART. Designed around practical microcontroller programming and communication workflows for embedded systems, robotics, and IoT experimentation.

PROJECTS.name: A.S.T.R.A (Autonomous System for Trading & Risk Analysis)
PROJECTS.description: A local-first market-analysis and risk-monitoring system focused primarily on Indian equity markets. It analyzes market data and technical indicators, monitors portfolio state and risk metrics, produces advisory BUY/SELL signals, records persistent telemetry, and supports notifications and reporting through integrations such as Telegram, email, and Google Sheets. Trade execution remains under human control.
